resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. The second character-design direction is the measured axis. Put its named face geometry and proportions on the visible subject. Translate its silhouette and layers into large asymmetric garment shapes, and repeat its seam curves and closures as front-readable clothing details. Photorealistic adult editorial treatment: broad curved light paths, flowing shadows, and repeated organic shapes. Use garnet, sapphire, and emerald fields with restrained gold highlights, translucent color layers, luminous reflections, and crisp bright accents, upward beams, rising forms, and restrained ceremonial glints, and soft color bloom and halation outside a readable silhouette. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: An adult character has a practical athletic silhouette with mobile shoulders and believable functional balance, a diamond-shaped adult face with defined cheek planes and a compact chin, and statuesque adult proportions with an upright spine and measured limb length. The design is unified by practical modular panels, secure closures, and small functional details. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—frame literally from the complete crown through both feet, with generous visible background margin above the hairstyle and below both shoes.
